meta.title: Dry Blood
meta.source_file: Dry Blood By Parallels (Official Music Video).mp3

interpretation.summary: A driving, melancholic 80s-inspired synth-pop track featuring a relentless four-on-the-floor beat, a plucky octave bassline, and soaring sawtooth leads over a dark A minor harmony.

vocabulary.timbre: Dominated by classic 80s synthesized textures: sawtooth bass and leads, digital drum machine sounds (especially a gated reverb snare), and glassy FM arpeggios.
vocabulary.brightness: The track is spectrally bright, filled with crisp 16th-note hi-hats, sizzling sawtooth waves, and a polished high-end sheen on the overall mix.
vocabulary.envelope: Envelopes are generally tight and punchy; the bass has a quick pluck (short decay), drums are sharp, and leads have a fast attack to cut through the dense mix.
vocabulary.register_density: A dense arrangement with a low-register octave bass providing a solid foundation, thick mid-range pads and vocals, and high-frequency arpeggios and percussion.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: The piece is firmly in A minor, using classic diatonic chord progressions (e.g., Am-G-C-F) to create a melancholic and emotive darkwave atmosphere.
vocabulary.groove: A propulsive and danceable groove is established by a steady 120 BPM four-on-the-floor kick, a heavy backbeat snare, and a constant 8th-note bass pulse.
vocabulary.space_grit: The production uses significant space, defined by a large, cavernous reverb on the snare and vocals, with delay and chorus effects sweetening the synth layers.

tracks.name: Power Kick
tracks.description: The foundational kick drum, providing a constant pulse throughout most of the song. Enters after the intro at 0:08.

tracks.name: Gated Snare
tracks.description: A classic 80s snare sound characterized by a sharp transient followed by a massive, gated reverb tail. Enters with the main beat at 0:08.

tracks.name: 16th Hats
tracks.description: A bright, metallic, digital-sounding hi-hat that provides the high-frequency rhythmic energy and drive. Enters at 0:08.

tracks.name: Octave Bass
tracks.pattern: Pulsing 8th notes, alternating between root and octave, following the chord progression.
tracks.description: The primary driving melodic and rhythmic element. A plucky, filtered sawtooth synth that defines the song's energy. Enters at 0:08.

tracks.name: Power Lead
tracks.pattern: Soaring, thematic melody lines, often harmonized, during high-energy chorus sections.
tracks.description: A thick, detuned sawtooth lead that carries the main instrumental hook. It's drenched in reverb and delay, appearing in choruses to lift the energy.

tracks.name: Crystal Arp
tracks.pattern: Fast-paced 16th-note arpeggios that outline the chord changes.
tracks.description: A glassy, clean FM synth arpeggio in the upper register that adds a layer of complexity and movement, particularly during verses and instrumental breaks.

tracks.name: Atmosphere Pad
tracks.pattern: Long, sustained chords that change with the harmony every 1 or 2 bars.
tracks.description: A dark, brooding pad with a slow attack and long release that fills out the harmonic space and provides an atmospheric backdrop for the other elements.
